title: Traditional Mexican Champurrado (Thick Spiced Chocolate Masa Drink)
originalTitle: Traditional Mexican Champurrado (Thick Spiced Chocolate Masa Drink)
ingredients: 3 cups whole milk (or evaporated milk + water)
1 tablet (90g) Mexican chocolate (Abuelita or Ibarra), chopped
1/3 cup piloncillo (grated cone sugar) or dark brown sugar
Pinch of salt and 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Toast the masa harina in a dry skillet over medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes until lightly golden and fragrant, then whisk with 1 cup warm water until completely smooth and lump-free.
In a saucepan, simmer the remaining 1/2 cup water with the cinnamon stick and piloncillo (or brown sugar) for 5 minutes until dissolved.
Pour in the milk and chopped Mexican chocolate tablet, whisking until melted and steaming.
Slowly stream in the toasted masa slurry while whisking continuously. Simmer on medium-low for 6–8 minutes until thick, velvety, and frothy.
